newsitem.title: CANADA: Alcan settles Canadian lawsuit, plans new smelter.
newsitem.headline: Alcan settles Canadian lawsuit, plans new smelter.

text.p: Alcan Aluminium Ltd. ( ) on Tuesday settled a lawsuit against the British Columbia government over its canceled Kemano hydroelectric project and said it plans to build a C$1.2 billion ($876 million) smelter at Kitimat, British Columbia.

Subject to economic and market conditions, the new smelter could be operational as early as Jan. 1, 2003 and no later than Jan. 1, 2010, the Montreal-based company said. Under terms of the settlement, Alcan agreed to restart idle capacity at its existing Kitimat smelter and bring it up to full capacity by Jan. 1, 1998.
